sections.title: 1.3 Definitions, Acronyms and Abbreviations
sections.text_preview:
1.3.1 Actor

Actor is synonymous with user and is used to describe users who are performing actions in use cases.

sections.title: 1.3.2 Course Administrator
sections.text_preview: Course administrator is an actor who is acting as a professor or system administrator and who has the ability to manage courses and course pages.

sections.title: 1.3.3 Courseware System
sections.text_preview: Courseware system is a piece of software meant to help facilitate electronic classroom management and provide for electronic grading, assignment submission, discussion, and other learning tools.

sections.title: 1.3.4 System
sections.text_preview: System refers to the existing courseware system, a new courseware system, or any modifications being made to Moodle while it is being considered as a replacement for the existing courseware system.
